audit.why: 51.24% over 1247 games matches EVEN / 6-10: Olaf owns levels 1-5, it levels at 6, and Shen takes the two-item mark.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three level rows disagreed with the packet chart and with their own adjacent prose: levels 4-5 said Skill (prose says Olaf out-sustains), level 6 said Olaf (whys[4] literally ends 'call it even'), and 2+ items said Olaf (whys[6] says Shen outscales).
audit.why: The packet chart reads Olaf/Olaf/Olaf/Olaf/Skill/Skill/Shen, which is what the prose describes.
audit.corrected: phases[3]/[4]/[6].side and win[3]/[4]/[6] flipped in matched pairs, ratings moved to follow, and the three phase 'why' strings rewritten.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page named no Shen ability (packet defect), called Spirit's Refuge a 'W shield' in six places, and said Ragnarok 'cleanses' the taunt.
audit.why: Spirit's Refuge BLOCKS basic attacks near the spirit blade — it is not a shield; Shen's shield is the passive Ki Barrier, gained after casting a spell. That distinction is the whole trade: the refuge stops your autos but not Undertow, which is an ability. And Ragnarok's Riot text grants immunity to disables while he keeps attacking, not a cleanse. Shadow Dash at 18s on rank 1 is his single engage and his single escape, so the window after he spends it is the trade window.
audit.corrected: Named Ki Barrier, Twilight Assault, Spirit's Refuge, Shadow Dash (600 range, 18/16/14/12/10s) and Stand United (200/180/160s); separated the refuge from the passive shield; stated Undertow is an ability the refuge does not block; replaced every cleanse claim.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1] headed 'R to cleanse his E taunt' carried the axe-trading body, and dosFull[2] headed 'E for true damage' carried a Shadow Dash bait line. spikes[2] read 'make Shen unkillable to peel off you', which is garbled.
audit.why: Every body described a different action than its heading, so no entry gave the reader a reason to do the thing named.
audit.corrected: Bodies rewritten to match their headings; spikes[2] rewritten around the perma-slow and the Shadow Dash denial.

edits.before: Shen has no early kill threat on you — his W only blocks autos for a window and his Q empower is weak pre-items, so you out-trade him hard. Land Q to slow, walk up and E for the guaranteed true damage chunk, and let your passive ramp attack speed as you take his chip. The only thing to respect is his E taunt-dash: don't burn Ragnarok on cooldown, and bait the taunt before you fully commit your combo.
edits.after: Shen has no early kill threat — Spirit's Refuge only blocks basic attacks inside his spirit blade's zone, and Twilight Assault is weak pre-items. Land Undertow to slow (it is an ability, so the refuge does not stop it), walk up and E for the guaranteed true-damage chunk. The one thing to respect is Shadow Dash, 600 range on 18s at rank 1: bait the taunt before you commit, and don't burn Ragnarok early.

edits.before: Levels 4-6 stay yours. Keep picking the axe back up to perma-slow him, force short trades where W-omnivamp heals you back, and his only answer is E taunt — which Ragnarok cleanses at 6. Once you have R you can dive him outright since his W-shield and Q empower don't out-damage your true-damage all-in. Shove and crash to deny his roam-to-teamfight value before his scaling kicks in.
edits.after: Levels 4-6 stay yours. Keep picking the axe back up to perma-slow him, force short trades where Tough It Out's shield covers his chip, and his only answer is Shadow Dash — 18s at rank 1, so the moment he spends it the lane is yours. At 6, Ragnarok makes you immune to the taunt while you keep swinging, so dive him. Shove and crash to deny his roam value before his scaling kicks in.

edits.before: This flips. Shen's whole point is the late game: his W-shield front line tanks your DPS, his global R lets him impact the map you can't reach, and your flat E true damage stops scaling while he stacks resists. Convert your early-to-mid lead into towers and dives BEFORE 2 items — if the game goes even into the mid-game, Shen's utility and global presence quietly out-values your snowball-or-fade kit.
edits.after: This flips. Shen's whole point is the late game: stacked resists and Ki Barrier tank your DPS, Stand United lets him impact a map you can't reach on a 160s rank-3 cooldown, and your flat E true damage stops scaling. Convert your early-to-mid lead into towers and dives BEFORE 2 items — if the game goes even into the mid-game, Shen's utility and global presence quietly out-values your snowball-or-fade kit.

notes: Olaf's Undertow is flagged 'grounding' in the kit file purely because Riot's text says the axe lands in the ground — a parsing artifact, so no grounding-denies-Shadow-Dash advice was written here despite the temptation. Whether Reckless Swing (an on-attack effect) is blocked by Spirit's Refuge is not derivable from Riot's text, so nothing asserts it either way — only the plain 'the refuge blocks basic attacks, not Undertow' claim is made. Whether Ragnarok removes an already-applied taunt is likewise unstated.
